product_one_liner.value: Vim connects healthcare systems, data, and teams and runs AI-enabled workflows within existing EHRs for health systems, ACOs, MSOs, payers, and health technology companies.

pricing_page.notes: Vim Scribe publicly lists $50 per user per month after a 30-day free trial; this is product-specific pricing, not a platform-wide price list.

employee_band.notes: Latest dated headcount found: 419 as of September 30, 2026. Public estimates conflict: PitchBook lists 150 as of 2024.

eng_blog.notes: The blog is predominantly industry, product, and marketing content; the reviewed technical/product explainers do not establish two engineer-authored posts about building Vim.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official job board states: “There are no current openings.”

model_provider.notes: No explicit disclosure of Vim’s own production model or model provider was found in the reviewed developer documentation, product/AI material, blog, trust center, or privacy material. No public subprocessor roster identifying an AI provider was located; marketplace AI vendors are not evidence of Vim’s own model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Vim claims SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliance. HIPAA is a compliance obligation, not a formal certification. HITRUST is also claimed but is outside the five requested categories.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook records a completed $24.7 million Series C on July 1, 2021; CB Insights independently lists July 1, 2021 as the latest Series C. This is later than the widely reported May 2021 completion of a $60 million Series B.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round is July 2021, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official job board states: “There are no current openings.”

launched_6mo.notes: No dated qualifying launch was found for May 9–November 9, 2026. The latest dated developer release is March 10, 2026. The site also promotes AgentFlow without a launch date; that undated promotion cannot establish a launch in the requested window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Jo Lim’s profile dates her VP of Customer role at Vim from January 2024 through December 2025, establishing a VP departure within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026; her next role began January 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: An archived Vim BDR posting names all four as hands-on tool experience; an archived sales posting explicitly requires maintaining records in Salesforce. These are historical stack signals, not evidence of current openings.
